verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal has an API reference section at /api/. It covers OAuth 2.0 client credentials, expense, card-transaction and custom-field endpoints, async job polling, and webhooks, and the portal also serves an llms.txt for AI consumption. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable code examples or sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
